subject: Staged prepay conversion roadmap and concession request
messages:
From: Claire Johnson <claire.j@gammahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Switching billing cadence to annual prepay — constraints and asks

Hi Aditya / Laura,

We're trying to move GammaHealth from month-to-month billing to an annual prepay for FY27. Procurement asked me to get:
- A clear price schedule for 12-month vs 24-month commits,
- Any ramp / usage true-up mechanics (quarterly vs annually),
- One-time credits or onboarding concessions that can be applied up front,
- Confirmation on billing / invoicing cadence (PO + single invoice preferred).

Important constraints: our budget is approved for a phased spend — they expect lower consumption in Q1 while we pilot two products, with a ramp in Q2/Q3. We need flexibility for a quoted ramp schedule and the ability to true-up without penalties. Also SOC2 evidence and a short SOW would help speed procurement.

Can you send a proposal by EOD Friday? We're targeting a final PO the week of 6/22.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Johnson
Head of Procurement, GammaHealth
claire.j@gammahealth.com
+1 415 555 0132

Attachments: none

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.j@gammahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Switching billing cadence to annual prepay — constraints and asks

Claire — thanks for the clear constraints. Draft proposal below and attached a pricing worksheet + draft SOW for your procurement team. High level options: 

1) 12-month annual prepay (single invoice):
   - Baseline commit: $120,000/year (estimated based on current MRR)
   - Discount: 15% off list (applied to committed units)
   - Quarterly true-up: measured and billed/credited at quarter boundaries; excess usage billed at pay-as-you-go rates

2) 24-month committed prepay:
   - Year 1: $110,000 (year 1) with 20% discount off list
   - Year 2: step-down pricing (additional 5% off) if volume ramps to forecasted levels; otherwise revert to Year 1 pricing with true-up

Concessions / onboarding: one-time onboarding credit of $10,000 for professional services (applied to first invoice) and 60 days of extended trial for pilot workloads while you ramp.

Flexibility notes: we can structure a staged ramp schedule in the SOW (example: 50% of commit available for pilot months 1–3, then 75% for months 4–6, then full commit month 7+). True-ups will be quarterly to minimize accounting churn.

Things I need from you to finalize: confirmed target PO date, whether the procurement team requires invoice-level splitting by product, and any internal minimums for year-1 committed dollars.

I've CC'd Laura for billing/legal redlines. If you want a single invoice and PO we can do annual upfront invoicing. For discounts beyond 20% or additional credits I'll need a quick approval from Finance (looping Rishi in the next message).

Attachments: GammaHealth-Pricing-worksheet-v3.xlsx, SOW-GammaHealth-2026-v2.pdf

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0199

From: Claire Johnson <claire.j@gammahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Switching billing cadence to annual prepay — constraints and asks

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from procurement and finance: 
- Our CFO is asking if you can front-load a larger rebate in Year 1 (we're targeting a 25% effective discount on committed units in Year 1 to justify the upfront spend).
- Can onboarding credits be applied as an invoice-level credit (so it shows on the first annual invoice)?
- We need the SOW to show the staged ramp schedule explicitly (pilot months 1–3 at 50%, months 4–6 at 75%, full in month 7).

If we can get Year 1 to 25% off (or equivalent USD credit), procurement will prioritize the PO for week of 6/22. Otherwise they will need more time for internal approvals.

Also: DOCS request — please send a DocuSign-ready SOW and confirm SOC2 link for vendor attestation.

Claire

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Johnson <claire.j@gammahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: GammaHealth — concession ask (25% Y1)

Rishi — quick context: GammaHealth is ready to convert to annual prepay if we can provide an effective 25% Year 1 concession (they'll PO week of 6/22). Current pricing proposal is 15% for 1yr / 20% for 2yr. They've asked specifically for the larger Year 1 credit to offset pilot risk. 

Options I see:
- Approve a one-time USD credit to achieve 25% effective discount in Year 1 (instead of increasing the % list discount). This preserves list pricing and makes year-over-year clean.
- Approve a temporary increase to list discount to 25% for Year 1 only (requires Finance sign-off).

We'd like to keep onboarding credit but convert some of it into an extra year-1 credit if you approve. If we push this to the finance weekly review we'll miss their PO window. Your quick call/ok would help close and hit the quarter target.

Thanks — Laura

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.j@gammahealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GammaHealth — concession ask (25% Y1) — APPROVED (conditional)

Claire / team — after reviewing the numbers and lifetime value, Finance will approve a concession to meet GammaHealth's request with the following conditions: 
1) We will deliver an "effective 25% Year 1 benefit" achieved via a one-time invoice credit of $20,000 applied to the first annual invoice plus the standard 15% list discount on committed units.
2) The staged ramp schedule must be codified in the SOW (pilot months 1–3 @ 50%, months 4–6 @ 75%, full commit month 7+). True-ups remain quarterly.
3) Minimum committed dollars for Year 1 must be $100,000 to qualify (to ensure unit economics).
4) This is a one-time concession; Year 2 pricing will revert to the agreed committed rate (unless renegotiated).

Aditya — please update the SOW and pricing worksheet to show the $20k invoice credit, add the ramp table, and prepare a DocuSign link for the SOW + PO. Laura, please confirm billing instructions (single annual invoice to procurement@gammahealth.com and PO # to be added).

Claire — once the DocuSign is set we can turn this around same day and issue the invoice. Happy to set a quick call if you want to walk the team through the ramp / true-up mechanics.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW-GammaHealth-2026-v2.pdf (updated), GammaHealth-Pricing-worksheet-v4.xlsx
